title: Exact Compositional Transfer of Bounded Linear Recovery: Relative Weights and Labelled Coset Costs
description: For an inner code and a target/helper split, shortening and puncturing the inner dual onto the helper coordinates give a canonical nested pair. Its relative generalized Hamming weights are the exact minimum helper-union costs for recovering target subspaces of each dimension, but these scalar minima do not compose. The paper shows that exact finite transfer is captured by labelled prescribed-coset support functions: minimizing them over the complete outer functional dual yields the minimum cost of a nonconfined recovery system, and the functions compose associatively by exact min-sum substitution through finite towers. After the finite outer-dual-distance gate, the criterion collapses to the corresponding relative generalized Hamming weight plus the inner dual distance; below either exact threshold, zero-extension preserves every bounded normalized recovery equation and its exact helper support. Separations show that the complete relative-weight hierarchy does not determine bounded repair reliability and that different ambient inner-dual realizations of the same abstract nested pair can have different confinement thresholds. ERGO-comp executes the recursion while separately retaining minimizing lifts for replayable coefficient witnesses. The mathematical proofs are software-independent.
